$extensions.evidence: Measured. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) sets animation: none !important and transition: none !important on * in entry.tFlogPss.css. The probe was not run under emulation, so this is the authored rule, not a second computed pass.
notTokenised: The stylesheet declares a full GSAP easing set (--ease-in-power1 through --ease-out-gentle). Only the three easings used by visible controls are tokenised.
Hero word delays (--intro-d .25s, --d calc(...)) are per-index and were not tokenised as a scale.

notTokenised: Marketing pill ends are border-radius 100% on 0.7rem caps, plus an SVG path. Not a single radius token.
Login light theme is declared on :root and stored under authLight. The signed-out page mounts .dark, so authLight was not computed.
Status ramps (red, green, pink, purple, blue-50 through blue-800) are declared on :root and :root [class~=dark]. Only the roles computed or named on the signed-out form are tokenised.
Fonts Sohne, SohneMono, Romie and FoundersGrotesk are declared as --font-* and listed in document.fonts as unloaded. They were not painted on / or /login.
Hover, pressed, loading, error, checkbox, radio, switch, select, textarea, toast, menu, tooltip, tabs and table were not on the signed-out surfaces.
The preview browser could not produce screenshot frames. Screenshots are from a separate headless load of the public home page only.
